text:
maya (eng-platform): quick heads-up 514 starting planning for CI runner region split + separate GitHub orgs for billing. goal: lower egress costs and give APAC/EMEA local capacity.
dan (devex): +1. propose opt-in model: teams update workflow `runs-on` to target regional pools, we don't force-move repos.
zhou (eng-sre): need a safe drain/cordon flow. suggested commands: `runnerctl cordon --pool=emea` then `runnerctl drain --pool=emea --grace=600s`. gate: `runner_jobs_active == 0`.
ria (eng-security): security checklist: create org skeletons, update SSO invites, rotate GH App installation tokens at cutover, and update OIDC audience list. legal may need to approve billing accounts for some customers.
infra-bot: note: AMI builds reference regional SSM endpoints; will parameterize image build. also adding IAM role templates per target org.
maya (eng-platform): deliverables: devex -> migration playbook + sed patch; sres -> drain runbook + dashboard; security -> token rotation timeline; infra -> AMI/IaC checklist. target draft by next Wed EOD.
deploy-bot: webhook-healthcheck POST https://hooks.redwood.dev/ci-health -> 200 OK {"ok":true}. supports `X-Hub-Signature-256`.
dan (devex): sample workflow snippet: ```yaml
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, region-emea]
``` will provide script to patch repos.
zhou (eng-sre): canary plan: move 3 low-traffic infra repos, observe queue time and tail latency for 48h, then expand. add alert if `job_queue_time` > 2x baseline.
maya (eng-platform): blockers? ria (eng-security): two enterprise customers flagged for billing/legal signoff. will sync with GTM/legal.
maya (eng-platform): thanks all 44d I'll post the kickoff doc link here and schedule a 30m sync Monday 9am PT. Drop any blockers here before then.
